# ResizeImage

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Images](BlitzBasic-Images)

</div>


```blitzbasic
ResizeImage:Void image:Int32, width:Float32, height:Float32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `image` | In | Int32 | required | The image. |
| `width` | In | Float32 | required | New width of a frame in pixels. |
| `height` | In | Float32 | required | New height of a frame in pixels. |

## Description

Changes the size of every frame of an image to a new width and height in pixels, stretching the picture. The handle moves with the picture. Resizing again and again loses quality, so keep the original or use [CopyImage](CopyImage) first.

## Differences

* The picture is stretched with smooth filtering, where the original used simple pixel picking. Edges of resized images are softer.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Local img = CreateImage(40, 40)
SetBuffer ImageBuffer(img)
Color 255, 160, 0
Oval 0, 0, 40, 40, 1
Color 0, 0, 0
Oval 12, 12, 16, 16, 1
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Local wide = CopyImage(img)
ResizeImage wide, 120, 40
Local tall = CopyImage(img)
ResizeImage tall, 40, 120
Cls
DrawImage img, 20, 100
DrawImage wide, 90, 100
DrawImage tall, 240, 60
Flip
WaitKey
```
